input.question: Who was Anna Palaiologina married to?

documents.text:
14th century  
Spouse Manuel II Palaiologos  
John Komnenos Asen  
Issue Nikephoros II Orsini  
Thomais Komnene  
Angelina  
House Angelos  
Father Andronikos Angelos Palaiologos  

Anna Palaiologina (Greek: Ἅννα Παλαιολογίνα) was a queen-consort (basilissa) of the Despotate of Epirus as wife of Manuel II Palaiologos. She was regent for her son Nikephoros II Orsini in 1337–1338. She later married the Lord of Valona, John Komnenos Asen. 

Life [edit]  
She was a daughter of a Byzantine aristocrat, the protovestiarios Andronikos Angelos Palaiologos, a grandson of the ruler of Epirus, Michael.

raw_card.answer: Manuel II Palaiologos, John Komnenos Asen
raw_card.claim: Anna Palaiologina was married to Manuel II Palaiologos and later to John Komnenos Asen.
